RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

This Residential Lease Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into by and between Meridian Point Properties LLC ("Landlord") and the undersigned tenant ("Tenant") for the premises located at 4417 Cobalt Ridge Drive, Unit 12B, Springfield ("Premises").

1. TERM. The initial term of this Agreement shall begin on June 1 and shall end on May 31 of the following year (the "Initial Term"). Tenant shall have no right to occupy the Premises before the start date without Landlord's prior written consent.

2. RENT. Tenant shall pay Landlord monthly rent of $1,850.00, due on the first day of each calendar month. Rent shall be paid by direct deposit, money order, or through the Landlord's online tenant portal. A payment received after the third day of the month is considered late and subject to the late fee described in Section 3.

3. LATE FEES AND OTHER CHARGES. If rent is not received by the fifth day of the month, Tenant shall pay a late fee of $75.00. In addition to the monthly rent described in Section 2, Tenant shall pay a recurring monthly convenience fee of $45 for use of the online tenant portal, which is the sole method by which rent payments are accepted without an additional processing surcharge. The convenience fee is billed automatically together with rent and is not refundable under any circumstance.

4. SECURITY DEPOSIT. Tenant shall pay a security deposit of $1,850.00 prior to move-in. Landlord may retain all or any portion of the security deposit for damages, cleaning, unpaid rent, or any other reason Landlord considers appropriate at its sole discretion. Landlord is not required to provide an itemized list of deductions, and normal wear and tear is not defined or excluded under this Agreement.

text: 6. USE OF PREMISES. The Premises shall be used solely as a private residence for Tenant and Tenant's immediate household as listed on the application. Tenant shall comply with all applicable building rules, occupancy limits, and municipal codes.

7. MAINTENANCE AND REPAIRS. Tenant shall keep the Premises in a clean and sanitary condition and shall promptly notify Landlord of any needed repairs. Landlord shall maintain the structural components, plumbing, heating, and electrical systems of the Premises in good working order, consistent with applicable housing codes. Tenant shall be responsible for replacing light bulbs and HVAC filters during the tenancy.

8. ALTERATIONS. Tenant shall not make any alterations, including painting, installing shelving, or modifying fixtures, without Landlord's prior written consent. Any approved alterations become the property of Landlord upon installation.

9. RIGHT OF ENTRY. Landlord may enter the Premises at any time, for any purpose, including routine inspection, showing the unit to prospective tenants or buyers, or general maintenance, and no advance notice to Tenant is required. Landlord will make a reasonable effort to notify Tenant when practical, but the absence of notice shall not constitute a breach of this Agreement or grounds for any claim by Tenant.

10. GUESTS. Tenant may host guests for social visits, but any guest who stays overnight more than one time in any calendar month must be registered with Landlord's office in advance. Any guest present at the Premises for any portion of more than three days total in a calendar month, whether consecutive or not, shall be deemed an unauthorized occupant unless added to the lease and subject to a background check and an additional occupant fee of $200 per month, and Tenant shall be in default for any unregistered guest who exceeds this limit.

11. PETS. No pets of any kind are permitted on the Premises without Landlord's prior written consent and execution of a separate pet addendum, which may include an additional pet deposit and monthly pet rent.

12. EARLY TERMINATION. Should Tenant need to terminate this Agreement before the end of the then-current term for any reason, Tenant shall be responsible for immediate payment of the entire remaining rent due for the balance of the term, in a single lump sum, regardless of how quickly Landlord is able to re-rent the Premises, in addition to a lease-break administrative fee of $500. Landlord shall have no obligation to mitigate damages or to actively seek a replacement tenant before collecting the full remaining balance from Tenant.

13. UTILITIES. Tenant is responsible for all utilities serving the Premises, including electricity, gas, water, sewer, and trash, except as otherwise noted in this Agreement. Tenant shall establish utility accounts in Tenant's own name within five days of move-in.
14. INSURANCE. Tenant is strongly encouraged, but not required, to maintain a renter's insurance policy covering personal property and liability during the term of this Agreement.

15. QUIET ENJOYMENT. Landlord covenants that Tenant, upon paying rent and performing all covenants of this Agreement, shall peaceably and quietly hold and enjoy the Premises for the term of this Agreement, subject to the terms set forth herein, including Section 9.
16. SUBLETTING AND ASSIGNMENT. Tenant shall not sublet the Premises or assign this Agreement without Landlord's prior written consent, which may be withheld in Landlord's sole discretion.

17. DEFAULT. If Tenant fails to pay rent when due or otherwise breaches any provision of this Agreement, Landlord may pursue all remedies available under applicable law, including termination of this Agreement and recovery of possession of the Premises.
18. GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the state in which the Premises is located.

19. ENTIRE AGREEMENT. This Agreement, together with any addenda referenced herein, constitutes the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior negotiations, representations, or agreements, whether written or oral.

20. SIGNATURES. By signing below, Tenant acknowledges having read and understood all provisions of this Agreement, including the sections governing fees, renewal, security deposit, entry, guests, and early termination, and agrees to be bound by its terms.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.
